title: Thirudan Police
desc: Vishwa's disinterest in life gives way to determination after his father's murder. Subsequently, he becomes a disciplined police officer, hoping to make a difference.

title: Vennila Kabadi Kuzhu
desc: Having never won a tournament, a team of kabaddi players are ridiculed by their villagers. Their redemption finally arrives while playing in Madurai, for which they pay a heavy price.

title: Ponmana Selvan
desc: Raja, the eldest of three brothers, finds out that he is adopted and is shocked to learn the truth. To make matters worse, his brothers start avoiding him, but he helps them when they land in trouble.

title: Naadodigal 2
desc: Four friends fight casteism in society and help two lovers unite with each other against the will of their respective families.

title: Venghai
desc: Selvam's father works for the upliftment of a village and expects his son to follow in his footsteps. However, Rajalingam, a corrupt minister, tries to sabotage their reputation for his own gain.
